steps.content: The city hall is enveloped by a deadly silence.
Upon entering the hall, you find only one person seated quietly amidst the vacant chairs—a middle-aged woman of dignified bearing.
She gazes calmly ahead, her eyes seemingly fixed on the empty podium, the state flag behind it, or perhaps on something imperceptible to the eye.
Only when the sound of your footsteps fades does she turn to face you—it's Bernadette Cavendish, the one who requested this meeting.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't find you in the reception room, and was told you came here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you need a moment, I can go back and wait for you.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: It's all right. Let's talk here, if you don't mind.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: We were scheduled to go over some proposals today. David... sorry, Mr. Stewart, he used to speak from that podium. Now, their absence just made me feel a bit... displaced.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: So, let's just talk here. Consider it a way... to honor my departed colleagues.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName} of the MBCC. Thank you for taking the time to meet with me.
(Scene dims)

<color=#fb9259>Bernadette Cavendish</color> works for the council's largest coalition alongside Stewart who was pursuing re-election, and she was also a former pivotal member of Stewart's cabinet, holding significant sway in Eastside.

Earlier this year, however, she stepped down from the cabinet to run as an independent candidate, openly challenging the incumbent. Now, with Stewart's passing, she stands as one of only two remaining candidates—a sign that there's more to her than meets the eye.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: My aunt is a seasoned politician with years of experience. Last year, she antagonized Prime Minister Stewart and was removed from the cabinet for speaking up for the West District. She's now running as an independent candidate and will surely reach out to you. When that time comes, please keep one thing in mind:

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Bernadette Cavendish has no loyalty to any organization, sentiment, or principle. She acts purely in her self-interest. Chief, don't ever forget that.
Now, the seasoned politician locks eyes with you, and within this fleeting silence, she has already made her initial assessment of you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Nice to meet you, Ms. Cavendish.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've heard that you'd provide clues about the cabinet explosion. I'm interested in what you know and how you came across all this information.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: News, public reports, and some insiders of course—that's all. To be frank, this incident has put me in a rather delicate position.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: As both his former councilor and his rival, I had my share of disagreements with David, and his passing could have worked in my favor. So naturally, I found myself under suspicion—the 9th Agency questioned me right on the day of the incident.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: But thankfully, Langley Blackett cleared me of suspicion. We're old acquaintances—you can verify anything about me with her.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: With the election approaching, I'd rather keep my distance from this to steer clear of any controversy. I hope you can understand that, Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I appreciate your help to share in such cases, but there's something I don't quite understand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're well acquainted with my boss, Langley, why not talk directly to the 9th Agency? Why does it have to be me?
Bernadette gazes at you.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you—I have no direct leads about this case to share with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ! You are...?
She offers you a faint smile, shifting slightly in her seat to face you directly.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: As I explained earlier, I'm keeping my distance from this case, so I know nothing of its details.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Sorry I used it as a pretext for meeting you. I need your help with something—something I believe you'll be inclined to accept.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: I want you to protect someone.
As she speaks, she produces a photo and slides it across the table toward you.
The photograph shows a frail young girl, her gaze distant and unfocused before the camera.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: The late Prime Minister's out-of-wedlock daughter—<color=#fb9259>Elvira Stewart</color>.
Her words immediately puts you on high alert.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Will she be the next target?

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: That's for you to investigate, Chief. As I said, I don't know the details of the case—I've only heard rumors about the girl. Just rumors.
She taps the photo gently.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: David Stewart never married. Elvira is his only child, sixteen years old, her mother unknown. No school records, no medical history, no social documentation whatsoever. Even her residential address has been changing constantly.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: She's been well hidden during his lifetime—even the Stewart family only recently learned of her existence. That's how cautious he was.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Yet this cautious man, on the night before his death, set aside his pressing election concerns and secretly left his residence. He steered clear of even his most trusted allies and vanished until the following day. Upon his return, he died in the explosion.
A faint smile plays across her lips.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Chief, I couldn't possibly know.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: I just happened to hear that the day before the explosion was the girl's sixteenth birthday.

A hidden daughter, her sixteenth birthday, and the Prime Minister vanishing from the council on the same day... Bernadette's words seem to weave a spell, rapidly drawing your thoughts through the possible connections.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you saying she had something to do with the Prime Minister's death?

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: I didn't say so. Maybe it's just a coincidence, maybe not. No one can prove anything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you're asking me to protect her. That means you believe she's in danger.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: A few precautions won't hurt. In our line of work, no coincidence should be taken lightly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then why not escalate it? There's not just me—the 9th Agency and FAC could also take action, and they will.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Because it's wiser to handle things discreetly while there's no concrete evidence, and also because... someone has already stepped in to offer their "protection."

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>Stewart family</color> took her in immediately after the incident. You know how it is—even though they've never met, as <color=#fb9259>blood relatives</color>, they have a more legitimate claim to the orphan than any agency.

That's the highly conservative political dynasty with deep ties to Nirvana. It's hard to fathom that they weren't behind the stringent conservative policies on the West District, immigration, and Outlands trade in recent years.
You never know what the former Prime Minister really thought about his daughter, but... can the "blood relatives" that even he himself kept at arm's length be truly trusted?
Bernadette gives you enough time to collect your thoughts. Then, noticing your growing concern, she draws an exquisite envelope from her handbag.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Tomorrow evening, the Stewart family is holding a memorial service at Viers Mansion. Many important figures will be attending. I was invited too.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: They say, the Prime Minister cherished his daughter deeply and held high hopes for her. They shared a close bond—so she might be the person who knows her father best.
You immediately catch her implication.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That's far too risky, isn't it?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mr. Stewart was just murdered, and now they're presenting his daughter as the "heir to his will and intellect"? That's practically throwing her to the wolves! Even if they want to lure out the enemy, it's far too risky.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Maybe they're out of options. Stewart's influence has been waning since the West District was reconstructed. As the election nears, the stakes for his re-election only grow higher.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Losing the head at this crucial moment is truly devastating. All their allies, enemies, or onlookers even, are desperate for answers.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Perhaps that girl is the only card they could play—that's how I see it.

You came expecting information about the Underground, but this sounds more like a power play from the upper echelons. Such political maneuvering feels foreign to you, who's always been fighting on the front lines.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are the Stewarts involved in this case? What's their official stance? And those enemies and allies you mentioned...

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: I only know what's been made public. As for any undisclosed information about the case, I know nothing about it, nor can I delve any further.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: As for the truth you seek...
She slides the invitation toward you.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Given my status as a suspected former political rival, my presence at the memorial service might cause unwanted tension. I will entrust this invitation to you, Chief. The Cavendish family stands ready to offer any assistance you may require.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: In return for your efforts, I trust that you, who are investigating <color=#fb9259>the truth behind the cabinet attack</color>, will know how to leverage this opportunity with that girl.
You take the invitation—gold-embossed, elegant, and luxurious, ostentatiously bearing the Stewart family crest. After reading it, you slip it into your folder and turn your gaze back at Cavendish.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why <color=#fb9259>me</color>?
Another moment of silence passes before she offers a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: You think I have ulterior motives? That I'm seizing this chance to approach you, rope you in, and earn your trust to vote for me? That would be undignified, and unnecessary.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Since you don't have a liking for politicians like me, I won't trouble you beyond today. This is just a one-time personal request—to protect a child who has recently lost her loved one.
She lowers her gaze, a momentary veil of sorrow passing over her countenance.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: I serve as a politician, but I'm also a woman who once wanted to become a mother. I can't bear to see children suffer.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: As for why I chose you, the reason is quite simple: my niece, <color=#fb9259>Matilda Cavendish</color>, thinks very highly of you.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: You two are cut from the same cloth. Even caught in the political turmoil, you both cling to your principles, despise the power games, remain unfazed by fame and fortune, and more importantly...

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: In this game, you fear corruption, dread straying from your path. Even if circumstances pull you into a mire, you'll fight with everything you have to break free—and that is precisely what I admire.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Only people like you have that glimmer of hope... of not being consumed by the maelstrom.
She rises from her seat. When she mentions Matilda's name, for a brief moment, the councilor's expression does remind you of your hard-working friend.
Yet deep down, you can't shake the feeling that they are fundamentally different two people.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Well then, I have a few questioning sessions to attend. I'll take my leave now.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: This is farewell, Chief. I wish you good luck.
(CG1)
The meeting ends just like that. It's as if someone pushed open a door just enough for you to catch a glimpse inside, only to slam it shut immediately after.
You make your way back, clutching the invitation that will lead you to an unknown destination. Your footsteps echo through the silent hallway.
Until you find yourself face to face with a "visitor."
Does Paradeisos have any instructions regarding the election?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: No, Chief. Paradeisos does not interfere in such matters. This falls under the state's own jurisdiction—we're here simply to remind you of this fact.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your interactions with Ms. Cavendish have been impeccable thus far, and your approach to the situation is appropriate. However, you must exercise even greater caution moving forward.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is <color=#fb9259>their</color> election, Chief, with their own set of rules. You need not delve deeper, and should keep your distance unless absolutely necessary—it's for your own sake.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Such is the counsel from Paradeisos.
Schorl concludes its message and departs, leaving you alone. Amid the distant toll of a bell, you find yourself momentarily lost in thought.

Raising your gaze, you see the slanting ray of light cutting across the DisCity emblem and the faintly visible EDGE relief above it. On either side of the relief hang portraits of past Prime Ministers, each adorned with a corresponding nameplate.
Stewart, Cavendish, Harrington, Jacknal... Certain surnames keep recurring. While scrutinizing the unfamiliar faces peering down at you, a resemblance somehow starts to emerge among them.
These figures, etched into history, now hang overhead, their collective gaze bearing down upon you. Even the afternoon sunlight takes on a bluish tinge from the shadows.
As you gaze at them, Bernadette's words echo in your mind.
(CG2)

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: In this game, you fear corruption, dread straying from your path. Even if circumstances pull you into a mire, you'll fight with everything you have to break free—and that is precisely what I admire.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Only people like you have that glimmer of hope... of not being consumed by the maelstrom.
After a long moment, you finally avert your gaze and reach out to Nightingale.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nightingale, I need to attend a memorial service tomorrow. Let's prep for it.
Decision made, you stride forward, leaving behind the silent, shadow-shrouded hallway.
